name: TajGVK Hotels & Resorts Ltd
about: TajGVK Hotels & Resorts Limited, incorporated in 1995, is a joint venture between the Hyderabad-based GVK Group and Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL). The Company is engaged in the business of owning, operating & managing hotels, palaces, and resorts under the brand name of “TAJ”[1][2]
keyPoints:
Hotel Operator
The company is a JV between Hyderabad-based GVK Group and The Indian Hotels Company Ltd(IHCL). IHCL is a TATA enterprise that operates the largest chain of hotels in South Asia. It also manages the operations of all the 6 properties under the company. IHCL is a promoter with a 25.52% stake in the company as of Jun 24. [1][2][3]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 31.8% CAGR over last 5 years
